subproblem.title: Locality: X(η) = X(η′) when η = η′ on an open neighbourhood of spt X (from VO)
subproblem.statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 (the exact frozen Lean antecedent). Then (LOC) for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k), η, η' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and W ⊆ ℝ^N: if W is open, spt X ⊆ W and η(x) = η'(x) for all x ∈ W, then X(η) = X(η').
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) → X η = X η'
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof step 2 (0(c), (S3)). Simon Ch. 6, 2.11, book/chapter-06.txt lines 296–303: a current vanishes on test forms supported away from its support.
1. Let ψ := η − η' ∈ 𝒟^k(univ), the difference in the submodule TestFormOn univ k. Its underlying form is x ↦ η(x) − η'(x) (Submodule.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply).
2. For x ∈ W, ψ(x) = η(x) − η'(x) = 0 by hypothesis. So support ψ = {x | ψ(x) ≠ 0} ⊆ Wᶜ. Since W is open, Wᶜ is closed, so tsupport ψ = closure (support ψ) ⊆ Wᶜ (closure_minimal, IsOpen.isClosed_compl).
3. tsupport ψ ⊆ Wᶜ and spt X ⊆ W, and Wᶜ is disjoint from W. So tsupport ψ is disjoint from spt X (Set.disjoint_of_subset with disjoint_compl_left).
4. Apply (VO) with P := N, n := k, U := univ, S := X, ω := ψ: X(ψ) = 0.
5. X acts through the linear map X.toCurrent, so X(ψ) = X(η) − X(η') (LinearMap.map_sub). Hence X(η) − X(η') = 0, i.e. X(η) = X(η'). □
proof_key_steps: ψ := η − η' vanishes on the open set W, so tsupport ψ ⊆ Wᶜ (Wᶜ is closed).
spt X ⊆ W, so tsupport ψ is disjoint from spt X.
(VO) gives X(ψ) = 0, and linearity gives X(η) = X(η').

audit.reason: The prose and standalone type retain the exact VO antecedent, openness, support inclusion and equality hypothesis. Openness makes Wᶜ closed, so the difference form's topological support lies in Wᶜ and is disjoint from X.support. VO and linearity give the required equality. Every step is justified without circular reliance or additional obligations.
